# Command dotnet build

```text
Usage: dotnet build [OPTIONS] [PROJECT]
Options:
  -c, --configuration CONFIGURATION  Select the build configuration.
  --no-restore                      Do not restore during build.
  --verbosity LEVEL                 Set the logging verbosity.
Arguments:
  PROJECT                           Project or solution to build.
```

## Configuration XML RestoreSources
Type: string
Documented restore property. This is not the entire MSBuild property surface.
